research.name: Hello ImGui
research.note: C++ wrapper around Dear ImGui that runs one codebase on desktop, mobile and web, with docking layouts, themes and a custom 3D background.

effects: Dear ImGui parameter panel drawn over a full-window animated shader background (Seascape ocean shader in the demo)
dockable multi-panel application layout with a status bar and log pane set up by the framework

unverified: Only small static README screenshots were viewed (400x201 custom background, 200x134 docking, 250x148 manual); the online Emscripten demos were not run, so motion and interaction were not observed.
The homepage https://pthom.github.io/hello_imgui returned empty content to WebFetch, so the documentation site was not read.
Additional themes, borderless movable windows, power save mode, high DPI scaling and emoji or colored fonts are README claims and were not seen.

The ocean shader in the custom background screenshot is credited in the image to Alexander Alekseev (TDM, 2014), so the visual itself is third-party; the library's own part is hosting a custom background behind the widgets.
